scope: resolve metric and intermediate-data dependencies before tier-0 evaluation

checks.ordering: an acyclic shared dependency graph yields a deterministic prerequisite-first order, contains only the requested closure, and schedules a shared prerequisite once
checks.invalid_graphs: reject duplicate node IDs, repeated edges, missing dependencies, unknown roots, self-cycles and cycles in an unselected part of a graph
checks.builtins: an entropy and symbol-histogram request shares one histogram node; incidence diagnostics include the entity index first; selecting a ledger scalar alone schedules no intermediate data
checks.compatibility: preserve the registered default CSV digest, all 27 single-metric projections, full input validation and status values
checks.install: repeat the tests on Linux x86-64, Linux arm64 and macOS arm64 and exercise the plan API from the installed consumer

limits: plans resolve dependencies and gate existing streaming calculations. Persistent caching, arbitrary metric callbacks, task parallelism and scientific estimator validation remain separate.
